descriptionHtml:
Onikuma CW925 Lightweight Transparent Wired RGB Gaming Mouse - Transparent Black Edition

Redefine your desktop aesthetics and gaming speed with the visually stunning Onikuma CW925 Lightweight Transparent Wired RGB Gaming Mouse. Available at Turbo Computer, this cutting-edge PC hardware peripheral features a premium transparent black shell layout that showcases dynamic internal illumination structures. Masterfully engineered for competitive esports players, professional FPS gamers, and active digital website managers across Egypt who demand zero cable latency, rapid click actuation, and standout custom build designs, this mouse is backed by an official 1-year warranty for full absolute peace of mind.

The highlight of the Onikuma CW925 is its futuristic ultra-lightweight frame combined with an advanced optical gaming sensor capable of reaching a blistering 12,800 DPI limit. This provides elite-level cross-screen tracking sensitivity steps for intense macro execution and fine pixel adjustments. Operating over a high-speed wired USB connection framework, it ensures reliable data transmission with no input lag. Completed with vibrant multi-zone RGB backlit lighting channels that radiate brilliantly through the smoky transparent black outer casing, it features responsive programmable action buttons tailored for peak modern workspace performance.
